read.en: AMD rose 5.9% on Nov 12 to $585.30, trading $554.90–594.00 on heavy volume (1.72x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($522.2), 10-day ($496.0), 30-day ($549.9), 100-day ($527.3) and 200-day ($421.7); the 5-day and 200-day are rising. MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 11, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 10 ($411.36), and RSI is 57.5.

The rally cleared all three written resistances ($561.5–567.7, $574.2–579.2 and the $584.73 Jun 30 high), now support. Resistance is $594–601.8 (Nov 12 and Oct 12 highs), then $606.2–608.1 (Oct 13 high, Oct 9 close) and $620–620.7. Support is $578.4–584.7, then $554.9–567.7 (Nov 12 low, Nov 11 high) and $549.9–552.9 (30-day). A close above $601.8 would target $606–621; below $578.4, $555–568.
